cards.title: NTL ATLAS Qwen3 8B v1
cards.description:
An ATLAS adapter for Name That LLM, trained on the official 2,699 training
rows for five epochs with frozen Qwen3-8B-Base. The package contains 18
source-specific adapters, inference code, configuration, and provenance.

**Licenses:** The adapter weights and package documentation are **CC BY-SA
4.0**. The bundled Python code is **Apache 2.0**. See `LICENSES.md`,
`LICENSE-WEIGHTS-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt`, and `LICENSE-CODE-APACHE-2.0.txt` for the
scope and full terms. Kaggle's “Other” field refers to this combination.

Credit the adapter to Joseph Adamski (`josephadamski91`) and link to this
dataset when reusing it. The [ATLAS method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19583)
is by Minseok Ko and coauthors. The
[Qwen3-8B-Base model](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base) is by the
Qwen Team and is Apache 2.0. The official training data is provided through
[Name That LLM](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/name-that-llm) under the
competition's CC BY-SA 4.0 data terms.

The base model weights and training CSV are obtained separately. Their terms
and the licenses of third-party dependencies remain applicable. See
`CREDITS.md` for attribution and provenance.

cards.title: NTL two-stage LoRA part two
cards.description:
Inference assets for the notebook "Two-stage LoRA, part two" in the Name That LLM competition. Public LB 0.620.

**What is inside**

- `lora_qwen3_14b` holds a LoRA adapter and heads for the first 27 layers of Qwen3-14B-Base. Alone it scores 0.611 balanced accuracy in 5-fold CV split by prompt.
- `lora_qwen25_14b` holds the same for the first 32 layers of Qwen2.5-14B. Alone it scores 0.569.
- `deberta_v3_large` holds a fully fine tuned DeBERTa-v3-large encoder and its linear head. Alone it scores 0.546.
- `pool_v4.parquet` holds 75,783 public passages from the 18 competition models, merged and cleaned from 25 public datasets. One paragraph each, 30 to 300 words, no markdown, no duplicates, nothing identical to a train passage.

Each LoRA folder has `adapter` with the LoRA weights at rank 16 and alpha 32, `heads.safetensors` with 8 LayerNorms and the plain and centred heads, and `meta.json` with the pooled layers, the max length, the end token used in training and the label order. Every checkpoint was trained in two stages, first on public passages and then on the competition's training passages.

**License and credit.** CC BY-SA 4.0, because the pool includes CC BY-SA 4.0 material. The passages are model outputs generated and shared by the authors of these datasets, CC BY 4.0 unless noted. seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages, willrice/name-that-llm-openrouter-harvest, lxdlxdlxd/ntl-synth-generations-v1, prvsiyan/prvsiyans-extended-name-that-llm-dataset, alperen5252525/ntl-vertex-gemini-proxy-gpt-generations, haileycheng/name-that-llm-same-prompt-passages, kaplinskiy/ntl-gpt-proxy-passages, lucasboesen/ntl-free-proxy-generations, abdullah1afify/ntl-generations, dophuchung/ntl-proxy-generations, ziyuzhou1207/ntl-zz-proxy-generations, keshavatearth/ntl-gpt-new-prompts-v1, michaelsemenoff/ntl-own-extra-v1, jadkutbi/ntl-own-proxy-generations, pardheev/ntl-proxy-extra-passages, abhinavsaipodugu/ntl-proxy-gpt-gemini-passages, zakirkhanaleemi/name-that-llm-benchmarks-proxy-generations, zbigniewkirchner/ntl-extra-gpt-passages, arxitekton/ntl-claude-gen-v1, arxitekton/ntl-claude-gen-v2, maniceet/name-that-llm-openrouter-openai-generations, dedruck/ntl-proxy-gen, prvsiyan/ntl-own-prompt-generations-v1 under CC BY-SA 4.0, drjcfmd/ntl-generated-v2 under CC BY-SA 4.0, illiadolenko/ntl-generated-corpus-v1 under CC0. The Qwen3-14B LoRA also saw aswathvanan/ntl-proxy-passages, under CC BY-SA 4.0, in stage one. Base models Qwen3-14B-Base and Qwen2.5-14B, Apache 2.0, and DeBERTa-v3-large, MIT. No competition text is included.

cards.title: Name That LLM: Qwen3-8B LoRA + Claude Head
cards.description:
# Qwen3-8B LoRA for Name That LLM (with an auxiliary within-Claude head)

A LoRA fine-tune of **Qwen3-8B-Base truncated to 24 layers** for the [Name That LLM](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/name-that-llm) competition. It follows the public lora24 design (mean pools of layers 2/4/6/8/12/16/20/24, per-layer LayerNorm, linear heads, same-prompt triplets, plain + prompt-centered 18-way heads) and adds one thing: a **5-way within-Claude head** trained on the original Claude rows **plus** the free public [Extra API Passages](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages).

The 18-way heads only ever see original competition data, so the API prompts' topics can't leak into the 18-way decision.

## Held-out results (same 539 validation rows as the public lora24 `outer0` fold)

| Model | balanced accuracy |
|---|---|
| public lora24, plain head | 0.4559 |
| **this LoRA, plain head** | **0.4838** |
| **this LoRA + Claude-head gate** | **0.4932** |

**Public LB:** added as a third LoRA to the 0.549 LoRA x Adaptive Centering blend together with Claude gates, it scores **0.552**. See [0.552 | Adaptive Centering + Own LoRA + Claude Gates](https://www.kaggle.com/code/zbigniewkirchner/0-552-adaptive-centering-own-lora-claude-gates).

Within-Claude accuracy on true Claude rows: 0.63 (plain head restricted to Claude) -> **0.69** (Claude head).

## Files
* `final/`: fit on all 2,699 training rows. **Use this one for inference.** It contains `adapter/` (PEFT), `heads.safetensors` (the 8 LayerNorms), `readouts.npz` (`plain_*`, `center_*`, `claude_*` coefficients), `tokenizer/` and `anchor_features.npz` (features of train rows 0-2, for a parity check).
* `fold0/`: the validation fit plus `validation_features.npz`.

Base model: attach `qwen-lm/qwen-3/Transformers/8b-base/1`. Inference is a drop-in for the `lora_plain_proba` function of the public LoRA x Adaptive Centering notebooks. Point the glob at this dataset's `final/COMPLETE.json` (e.g. `/kaggle/input/**/ntl-qwen3-8b-lora-claude-head/**/final/COMPLETE.json`), and use `claude_coef`/`claude_intercept` to choose *which* Claude when the blend predicts Claude.

Training notebook: [ntl lora24 claude aux](https://www.kaggle.com/code/zbigniewkirchner/ntl-lora24-claude-aux). Upvotes appreciated!

cards.title: NTL two-stage LoRA checkpoints and public pool
cards.description:
Inference assets for the notebook "Two-stage LoRA on the public pool" (Name That LLM, public LB 0.592).

**Contents**
- `lora8b_v1/`: LoRA adapter + heads for the first 24 layers of Qwen3-8B-Base (local CV 0.569 alone).
- `lora14b_v1/`: LoRA adapter + heads for the first 27 layers of Qwen3-14B-Base (local CV 0.569 alone).
- `pool_v1.parquet`: 34,940 public passages from the 18 competition models, merged and cleaned from the datasets below (single paragraph, 30-300 words, no markdown, deduplicated, train punctuation rules).

Each checkpoint folder has `adapter/` (PEFT LoRA r16/alpha 32), `heads.safetensors` (8 LayerNorms + plain and centred linear heads) and `meta.json` (layers, max length, label order). Training: 1 epoch on the pool, then 2 epochs on the competition's training passages. Details are in the notebook.

**Licence and attribution.** CC BY-SA 4.0, because the pool includes CC BY-SA 4.0 material. The pool is built from these public datasets (CC BY 4.0 unless noted):
seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages, willrice/name-that-llm-openrouter-harvest, lxdlxdlxd/ntl-synth-generations-v1, prvsiyan/prvsiyans-extended-name-that-llm-dataset, prvsiyan/ntl-own-prompt-generations-v1 (CC BY-SA 4.0), alperen5252525/ntl-vertex-gemini-proxy-gpt-generations, haileycheng/name-that-llm-same-prompt-passages, kaplinskiy/ntl-gpt-proxy-passages, lucasboesen/ntl-free-proxy-generations, abdullah1afify/ntl-generations, dophuchung/ntl-proxy-generations, ziyuzhou1207/ntl-zz-proxy-generations, keshavatearth/ntl-gpt-new-prompts-v1, michaelsemenoff/ntl-own-extra-v1. The passages are model outputs generated by those datasets' authors. Base models: Qwen3-8B-Base, Qwen3-14B-Base (Apache 2.0). No competition text is included.
